decision: SURVIVES COVERAGE TEST BUT BOUND IS LOOSE: held-out conservative coverage is achievable in this synthetic split, but the alpha factor is too large to call the bound practically useful without substantial tightening.
interpretation: A 99th-percentile train calibration covered 100% of the held-out corner/disc cases in this split.
The resulting bound is conservative enough to have large slack, so coverage alone is not sufficient.
Next work must seek a tighter bound using explicit window leakage/support terms, spectral conditioning, and local amplitude/mode selection rather than a single empirical slope.
